div.head: Af 42.2
div.ab: Gif he þonne ciricean gyrne, sy ðonne be þære ciricean áre, swa we ær bufon cwædon.
Gif he ðonne cirican geierne, sie ðonne be ðære cirican are, swa we ær bufan cwædon.
Si ecclesiam incurrat, sit secundum ueniam ipsius ecclesie, sicut supra diximus.
Gif he ðonne cirican geierne, sie ðonne be ðære cirican are, swa we ær bufan cwædon.
If he however makes it to a church [for sanctuary], let it be according to church privilege, as we spoke of before above.
If, however, he flees to a church, the privileges of the church shall be respected, as we have declared above.
If he, however, reaches a church, it is then to be [dealt with] according to the privilege of the church, as we have said above.
Wenn jener aber Kirchen[zuflucht] erreicht, geschehe dann gemäss dem Vorrecht der Kirche so, wie wir zuvor oben verkündet haben.
But if that man reaches the [sanctuary of a] church, then let it be according to the privilege of the church, as we have declared above.

note.label: cross-reference
note.quote: 'If he then reaches a church, then let it be according to the church's privilege, as we said above'; the reference is to the law just quoted in full.

note.label: see
note.quote: as we spoke of before above. [n.] See Alfred §2.
